```yaml
name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  property-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: 5
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
        timeout-minutes: 5
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest hypothesis
        timeout-minutes: 10
      - name: Run property tests
        run: pytest
        timeout-minutes: 5

  atheris-fuzz:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: 5
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
        timeout-minutes: 5
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install atheris
        timeout-minutes: 10
      - name: Run atheris fuzzing
        run: |
          python -m atheris fuzz --max_total_time=60 -- ./fuzz.py
        timeout-minutes: 2
      - name: Upload fuzzing logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: atheris-logs
          path: fuzz_logs
        timeout-minutes: 5
```
